row.title: A role whose only loop is probed by its own role file is a title, not a manager
row.body: MANAGERS-1, measured 2026-11-25: all 18 roles had a role-<id> loop whose closing probe was file:agents/roles/<id>.md, which proves only that a file exists. Four (program-manager, research-publisher, legal-ip-manager, org-designer) owned nothing else; the loop fleet-lane had owner system. Live, https://ultrastable.io/api/v1/agents showed 9 of 18 managers with no runtime row (the roles table is written once at bootstrap and was never reconciled with the roster) and the other 9 with a dispatch beat 2.8 h old because a D1 rows-read breach holds dispatch to once per 3 h. Fix in code: doctrine/managers.json and seed/autonomy/managers.json (one register, switched by data), seed/worker/src/managers.js hireStep in the tick's reconcile step, python3 -m foundation managers --check in checks, detector managers-live.
